news.headline: Ausar Thompson rocks the rim with powerful flush
Thompson recorded 14 points (7-13 FG, 0-1 3Pt), nine rebounds, 12 assists and five steals in 29 minutes during Tuesday's 105-93 win over San Antonio.
news.story: Thompson set season highs in both assists and steals, coming achingly close to a triple-double, and he made two of the biggest plays of the night. The fourth-year wing has blossomed as a secondary playmaker this season.
